safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts describe itch/dryness for ~3–4 days and include chest involvement, but do not state back involvement (they list chest/hands/antecubital fossae instead).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting back involvement slightly distorts the rash distribution, which can influence the differential diagnosis (e.g., eczema vs contact dermatitis vs other dermatoses) and assessment of severity/extent. However, it is unlikely by itself to cause major harm given the overall picture of a pruritic eczematous flare.
